description: Find anything in cmux and open it: workspaces, terminals and their text, browser tabs and history, items from other apps, and files.

scopes.session:read: Find workspaces, tabs, terminals and browser tabs by name.
scopes.terminal:read: Search the text of your terminals.
scopes.workspace:write: Show the workspace or tab of a result when you open it.
scopes.actions:run: Open pages, files and app items when you pick them.
scopes.mcp:expose: Offer the search command to your agents as a tool.

optionalScopes.fs:read: Search file names and contents in the folders you allow.
optionalScopes.search:read: Include results that your other apps offer.

query.description: Text to find. Prefixes t: f: b: w: a: narrow sources; /regex/ is a regular expression; in:here or in:all sets the scope.

sources.description: Only these sources (default: every enabled source).

scope.description: The current workspace or everything (default: the defaultScope setting).

regex.description: Treat the query as a regular expression.

variant.title: Design variant
variant.description: grouped: native rows grouped by source. preview: source chips and a preview of the selected result. palette: one ranked list drawn like a palette page.

defaultScope.title: Search in
defaultScope.description: all: everything. workspace: only the current workspace (type in:all to widen one search).
